## Our Idea

The idea we chose to analyze was whether students should frequently create their own code examples when they are stuck because and if it may lead to stronger understanding of COMP110 material.

*Reason for choosing this idea*: it is very practical as it requires no extra work for professors or TAs, the course does not need to be redesigned or taught differently. This idea is simply in the hands of teh students. It offers a way for students to take learning into their own hands and amke an immediate change themselves.
